instruction: Please enable the background cone animation in VLC. I find it more visually appealing when no media is playing.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the background cone visualization in VLC (qt-bgcone setting). The evaluator checks if qt-bgcone is set to 1 (enabled) in the VLC configuration file. Similar UI customization task, opposite of variation 0.
metadata.verification: Verified using existing check_qt_bgcone metric function. Expected value: qt-bgcone=1 in vlcrc configuration file.

Complete coverage - single requirement task with single verification point
